decision_impact: EALS-050 (NAC) & EALS-052 (L-Serine) Reclassified to Tier 3 Exploratory; EALS-051 QALS Stats, EALS-037 MAJIQ LSVs & 51/51 Flagship Assertions Verified
headline: Primary-Table Trial & Splicing Concordance Audit, Epistemic Asymmetry Reclassification of NAC & L-Serine, and Executable Flagship Assertions
prior_state_or_assumption: (1) Screen-nominated antioxidants & amino acids (EALS-051 CoQ10, EALS-050 NAC, EALS-052 L-Serine): summary trial notes did not separate Stage 2 QALS primary vs. death-penalized futility p-values, co-formulated oral NAC+EH301 dosing in NCT07414212 from underpowered Louwerse 1995 subcutaneous NAC, or +0.625% media L-serine concentration dilution from survival days and monogenic (<0.5%) SPTLC1/2 contraindications; (2) CELF5 (EALS-037), Trautwig CSF (EALS-019) & MIROCALS (EALS-031): unphased MAJIQ local LSVs were summed across distinct denominators, MGH control subtraction lacked a bank-only negative control, and Day-112 trough plasma CCL2 p<0.05 was grouped with Day-8/120 p<0.0001; (3) Reproducibility & statistical registries: several flagship string checks lacked value-mismatch assertions and substring covariate matching misrouted unadjusted p-values.
new_evidence_or_revision: (1) Clinical trial & Epistemic Asymmetry precision: in Phase II QALS (NCT00243932, PMID:19743457, N=185), Stage 2 primary bias-adjusted one-sided futility gave p=0.14 (8.80 vs 9.44; 0.51 was an LTF CI bound) while prespecified death-score sensitivity met futility (p=0.025 < 0.10; post-hoc slope p=0.097) alongside oral GI absorption saturation between 1,800 and 2,700 mg/d (PMID:16344537), confirming EALS-051 Drop; conversely, Louwerse 1995 SC NAC (PMID:7763202, N=110: HR=0.74 [0.41–1.33], p=0.31; limb-onset HR=0.50, p=0.06), high-dose oral NAC human CSF entry (9.26 uM at 70 mg/kg BID, PMID:25765302; vs 600 mg/d oral NAC + 1,800 mg/d EH301 in NCT07414212), and zero controlled sALS L-serine RCTs (+0.7117d screen survival vs +0.625% media concentration increment; <0.5% SPTLC1/2-ALS exclusion PMID:34059824, PMID:43025655) reclassify EALS-050 and EALS-052 to Tier 3 Keep · Exploratory (shifting portfolio counts to 4 Core / 25 Exploratory / 7 Benchmark / 16 Drop); (2) Splicing, CSF & MIROCALS: withdrew unphased CELF5 whole-mRNA bounds in favor of exact Brown MOESM11 local LSVs (upstream 3225618-3244124 novel_acceptor dPSI=+0.1218) + Zeng 2025 NMD rescue (24.8%->44.6%, FDR=0.0235, PMID:40672339 bioRxiv preprint), added Trautwig non-MGH bank-only negative control (AUC=0.9444; LOO target-site recalibration AUC=0.8801), and refined MIROCALS Day-112 trough plasma CCL2 (p<0.05) and 247-death superiority thresholds (HR_crit=0.779 at 80% power vs 50% probability of observed HR<=0.70 at true HR=0.70); (3) Reproducibility hardening: converted all flagship checks to executable assertions, separated cached vs. staged SHA-256 denominators, enforced POSIX-sorted directory hashes, added public HTTPS fetch recipes for TDP-43 cryptic splicing tables, and fixed covariate-vs-unadjusted p-value routing across all 194 contrasts.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Places EALS-050 (#27/52) and EALS-052 (#28/52) at the bottom of Tier 3 Exploratory Discovery behind media-buffering, high-dose CSF GSH, low-serine dose-response, and mandatory SPTLC1/2 genetic exclusion gates; defaults the KCNQ2 (EALS-006) heterotetramer sandbox to physiological 2:2 stoichiometry; and locks 100% executable flagship assertions and clean-room Tier-A verification.

decision_impact: EALS-007 Modality Inverted to Neurovascular RNA; EALS-034 ASO 3J Benchmark & EALS-037 18-nt EJC Gate Locked
headline: sST2 Cys327 Disulfide & PAS Modality Inversion, ATG4B ASO 3J Off-Target Scan & CELF5 18-nt EJC Minigene Rule
prior_state_or_assumption: (1) IL1RL1 / sST2 (EALS-007): isoform-selective sST2 designs often treat the 5-amino-acid C-terminal tail (aa 324–328 SKECF) as an uncomplicated biologic neo-epitope or propose intronic RNase H1 gapmers inside Intron 8 without evaluating co-transcriptional ST2L cleavage or unpaired thiol chemistry; (2) ATG4B (EALS-034): published 16-nt LNA cryptic-5'SS blocker ASO 3J (Torres et al. 2024, PMID:39305312) had not been benchmarked head-to-head against transcriptome-wide human splice-site and bulge off-target tiers; (3) CELF5 (EALS-037): cryptic-exon validation commonly relies on 3-exon splicing minigenes for NMD readouts and leaves Pro201 RRM2 structural consequence and upstream LSV co-occurrence unphased; (4) SARM1 (EALS-030): theoretical 8-protomer MWC ceiling curves require side-by-side comparison against sub-IC50 base-exchange concentration shifts.
new_evidence_or_revision: (1) IL1RL1 / sST2 (EALS-007): PDB 4KC3 (resolved aa 21–317, PMID:23980170) disulfide mapping proves all 10 D1–D3 cysteines form 5 closed disulfides (2.03–2.05 A), leaving sequence-deduced Cys327 in 324-SKECF-328 as an odd 11th unpaired extracellular thiol prone to S-cysteinylation (+119 Da), S-glutathionylation (+305 Da), and dimerization (redox state in ALS CSF unmeasured), while GENCODE v46 C-terminome scanning (89,484 protein-coding transcripts) identifies endothelial CD98hc/SLC3A2 (-SKEDF) as the sole 4/5 human C-terminal match and Clean (>=2 mismatches) Zone 1 Intron-8 PAS window #1 (chr2:102346045-102346062(+)) spares Exon-8 5'SS Zone 2 (chr2:102343400-102343435(+)); (2) ATG4B (EALS-034): head-to-head GENCODE v46 (254,070 transcripts) + GGGenome sequence scanning shows unconjugated 16-nt 6-LNA/15-PS ASO 3J (chr2:241668980-241668995(+), Table 3 PMC11416411; heuristic 6-LNA Tm ~80.1 C / 1-mm ~74.1 C) hits 10 spliced 1-mm genes (CLN6, DOCK3), 1 exact 0-mm and 18 1-mm <=50 bp splice sites, and 5 pLI>=0.96 CNS genes (while separate IV 25-nt peptide-PMO Pip8b2-ATG4B caused transient Day-2 mouse urinary KIM-1 elevation, PMID:39305312), whereas 18-bp intrathecal 2'-O-MOE #2 (chr2:241668970-241668987(+), -10 bp shift) cuts sequence flags to 0/0/0/0; (3) CELF5 (EALS-037): AF-Q8N6W0-F1 + CELF1 homolog PDB 3NMR (PMID:20947024) show 0 RRM1–RRM2 contacts (cross-PAE 21.3 A) and loss of 5 beta4–beta1 H-bonds and 6/17 projected UGUU contacts upon Pro201 truncation, Zeng et al. 2025 (PMID:40672339 bioRxiv preprint, PMC12265704) show NMD inhibition elevates cryptic CELF5 splicing from 24.8% to 44.6% (FDR=0.0235; vs Brown RNA-seq 54.1% & Ribo-seq 38.6%, PMID:35197628), and CE PTC codon 30 sits 18 nt (<50–55 nt EJC rule, PMID:9671053) upstream of CE–Exon 6 (so 3-exon minigenes can score splice %PSI but evade EJC-NMD); (4) SARM1 (EALS-030): distinguished Leahey et al. 2025's empirical 8.6-fold (IQR 5.1–9.7) IC50/C_act concentration separation across 122 BEIs (PMID:42380237) from the illustrative low-reserve washout curve (L0=2.5, 2.83x peak).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: (1) EALS-007 (#6/52, Tier 2): promotes intrathecal CD98hc/TfR1-shuttled (contextual shuttle precedents PMID:37598178; PMID:39141703; cf. naked ASO capillary gap PMID:37188501) cytoplasmic sST2 3'-UTR siRNA (PMID:35654979) or Zone 1 Intron-8 PAS 2'-O-MOE SSO (prohibiting nuclear RNase H1 Intron-8 gapmers and Zone 2 Exon-8 5'SS masking) ahead of backup intact-FcRn sweeping mAb, gated on overnight-oximetry normoxic CSF Simoa (PMID:41635251) and BBB-brake polarity (PMID:37117777); (2) EALS-034 (#7/52) & EALS-037 (#8/52): pairs ATG4B #2 vs ASO 3J off-target splicing checks with early pre-inclusion cervical alpha-MN BaseScope ISH, and mandates endogenous Exon 1–7+ Oxford Nanopore phasing for NMD/isoform readouts on CELF5 #1 in patient iPSC-MNs (PMID:41286450).

decision_impact: All 6 Triage Verdicts & Tiers Confirmed; New 3D, Splicing & Haplotype Gates Locked
headline: Six-Candidate Deep Compute, AlphaGenome, SuSiE Haplotype & 3D Cryo-EM/X-Ray Synthesis

decision_impact: KCNQ2 (EALS-006) Gated on Intron-5 Microwalk (#4/52); Multiplex Margin Set at 6–9 mg
headline: QRL-201 ANQUR Readout, CONQUR Pivotal IND & KCNQ2 Tier-2 Gate Calibration
prior_state_or_assumption: (1) QRL-201 / STMN2 (EALS-002): headline ANQUR ALSFRS-R or Day-421 OLE plasma NfL summaries do not separate 3 mg vs. 10 mg CSF pNfH dose dissociation, 10 mg->3 mg washout kinetics, or post-hoc baseline-NfL tertile exclusion; (2) KCNQ2 (EALS-006) & Multiplex Dosing: conservation-ranked intronic windows around KCNQ2 Exon 5 lack wet-lab ISS vs. ISE polarity proof, and extrapolating single-agent ASO doses (12–100 mg) to 2-plex/3-plex combinations risks cumulative 24–48 mg polyanion DRG radiculotoxicity.
new_evidence_or_revision: (1) Phase 1 ANQUR (NCT05633459, N=69 total: completed N=17 MAD + N=52 DRF at 3 mg/10 mg vs placebo, plus ongoing N=41 3 mg OLE) showed Day-197 CSF pNfH -46% vs baseline at 3 mg vs ~5% at 10 mg, while Day-253 10 mg ALSFRS-R 50% slowing vs placebo relied on post-hoc exclusion of the top baseline-NfL fast-progressor tertile; (2) Pivotal CONQUR, KCNQ2 & Benchmarks: US FDA cleared the pivotal CONQUR IND on 16 Nov 2026 (planned H1 2027), while single-agent intrathecal ASO benchmarks nusinersen (12–50 mg, DEVOTE PMID:41634391), tofersen (100 mg, VALOR PMID:36129998), and tominersen (PMID:31059641) motivate gating KCNQ2 Exon-5 polarity before <=3 mg/strand (6–9 mg) multiplex dosing.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Moves EALS-006 (KCNQ2) to Tier 2 · Validation Gate (#4/52, Keep · Core) alongside EALS-001 (#3/52) and EALS-002 (#5/52) pending a dense Intron-5 exon-inclusion microwalk and NHP verification of <=3 mg lumbar-to-BA4 motor-cortex delivery; replaces unvalidated 24–48 mg 3-plex loads with a 6–9 mg (<=3 mg/strand) multiplex polyanion/DRG margin target.

decision_impact: Keep · Core Reinforced (#3/52); Tier 2 Multiplex Gate Retained
headline: Human Neuronal UNC13A Cryptic-Exon Blockade Restores Evoked Synaptic Release
prior_state_or_assumption: Preclinical UNC13A (EALS-001) steric-ASO validation rested on iPSC motor-neuron splicing and Munc13-1 protein recovery (Brown 2022 PMID:35197628; Ma 2022 PMID:35197626) without defining the quantitative human protein threshold required to rescue evoked synaptic transmission.
new_evidence_or_revision: Keuss et al. (2026, Nature, PMID:43015463, DOI:10.1038/s41586-026-11256-2) demonstrated that restoring >30% human UNC13A protein via Intron-20 cryptic-exon deletion (~75% protein rescue) or 2'-O-MOE ASOs rescues miniature and evoked AMPA EPSCs and MEA network synchrony across human cortical and spinal motor neurons. Postsynaptic mEPSC amplitude reduction remained unrescued, and single-target UNC13A rescue leaves orthogonal STMN2 polyadenylation and KCNQ2 Exon-5 skipping unaddressed.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Reinforces EALS-001 (#3/52, Keep · Core, Bio #1) causal validity while retaining Tier 2 positioning behind sponsor-owned ICH M3(R2) single-entity GLP intrathecal tox on clean window #2 chr19:17642537-17642554(-) and Stage 2 rs12973192/rs12608932 genotype-stratified 2-plex vs 3-plex testing.

decision_impact: Keep · Core Retained (#1/52); Bliss, GoF & CD38 PD Gates Bounded
headline: SARM1 Parallel Bliss Lower Bound, Rare GoF Ceiling & Off-Target CD38 Fluid Guardrail
prior_state_or_assumption: Combination models of STMN2 rescue plus SARM1 inhibition often assume indirect NMNAT2 epistasis and interpret bulk plasma cADPR drops as direct axonal SARM1 target engagement without bounding rare ARM-GoF residual NADase activity or ecto-CD38 fluid background.
new_evidence_or_revision: Evaluated clinical allosteric SIR2501 (NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2) and reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across three modeled bounds: (1) 1.0x parallel Bliss survival additivity (Krus 2022 PMID:35767949; Matson & Holzbaur 2026 DOI:10.64898/2026.11.07.764673) to ~2–7x (med ~3x) NMNAT2-transport-coupled MWC dose-sparing (Beccari 2025 PMID:40392845); (2) ~30–40% residual NADase ceiling at 100x Kd in rare ARM-broken GoF heterozygotes (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663); (3) modeled ~5–10% selective cell-free fluid cADPR drop under >90–95% ecto-CD38 fluid background vs ~45–50% implied CD38 inhibition if cell-free plasma cADPR drops -50% (cf. tissue cADPR PMID:32087251; PDB 9TZY BEXi adduct 17 PMID:42156967).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-030 (#1/52, Keep · Core) while requiring Cys311Ala non-covalency verification, <1% SARM1 GoF carrier sequencing exclusion, enzymatic CD38 counter-screening, and unbound CSF trough PK.

decision_impact: Keep · Exploratory Retained (#2/52); Assay-Bridge & Cox SAP Sized
headline: MIROCALS Primary Stratum Verification, CLSI EP09c pNfH Assay Bridging & Phase 3 Survival Sizing
prior_state_or_assumption: Follow-on low-dose IL-2 trial designs frequently treat clinical TRICALS risk scores, shotgun CSF mass spectrometry, or unbridged commercial pNfH/NfL immunoassay cutoffs as interchangeable with MIROCALS's BioVendor ELISA CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL responder stratum.
new_evidence_or_revision: Primary verification of MIROCALS (NCT03039673, PMID:40354799, N=220, 90 deaths: <750 pg/mL n=19 [0 deaths], 750–3,700 n=154 [57 deaths, HR=0.52; pooled <=3,700 n=173 HR=0.57 p=0.037], >3,700 n=47 [33/90 deaths, HR=1.37 p=0.38; 2.13x death-rate ratio], continuous interaction p=0.0011, ALSFRS-R slope interaction F=3.95 p=0.048, and sustained Day-112 trough Treg expansion p<0.0001) alongside Al Khleifat et al. (2026, J Neurol, PMID:42836993: TRICALS shares r^2 = 12.7% with CSF pNfH; nested pNfH x trt dChi2 = 14.24 vs TRICALS x trt dChi2 = 4.76) separates tryptic CSF MS noise (r = 0.278, PMID:40375307) from clinical immunoassays (serum NfL–CSF pNfH rho = 0.64–0.71, PMID:38683209; serum NfL > serum pNfH on ALSFRS-R slope, PMID:32385188; paired CSF–serum pNfH r = 0.652, PMID:29054919) and notes ~1.8x–4.5x inter-platform pNfH offsets (PMID:31251725; modeled unbridged lower CSF cutoffs reduce 247-death two-sided superiority power from 80% to ~43–50% at HR_high = 1.00 or ~14–23% at HR_high = 1.37), while enrolled N=137 ALSTARS (NCT07161999) stratifies 3 serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R with dual rhIL-2 + CTLA4-Ig.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-031 (#2/52, Keep · Exploratory, Tier 1) and locks pre-Phase-3 CLSI EP09c split-aliquot Passing-Bablok bridging (N>=40 paired ALS CSFs) to MIROCALS's ~79th BioVendor percentile plus complementary TRICALS + log(CSF pNfH) Cox adjustment across 247 Schoenfeld events (HR = 0.70).

decision_impact: Keep · Exploratory Retained (#23/52); Coupled CASM Washout Gate Added
headline: Stoichiometric PIKfyve–PI(3)P–LRRK2/CASM Coupling Narrows Pulsed Apilimod Window
prior_state_or_assumption: Intermittent pulsed PIKfyve inhibition (EALS-020) models typically assume an occupancy dead-zone before endolysosomal vacuolation onset (~79% parameter-grid pass rate) without accounting for immediate +PI(3)P-driven LRRK2/CASM stress coupling.
new_evidence_or_revision: Kuwahara et al. (2026, Life Sci Alliance, PMID:42994990) demonstrated direct, threshold-free PIKfyve -> +PI(3)P -> LRRK2 Rab10-pThr73 / ATG16L1 CASM recruitment alongside Drosophila C9orf72 secreted DPR data (DOI:10.64898/2026.11.09.765393). In modeled pulsed q48h–q72h turnover simulations (>=55% substrate clearance and end-of-cycle stress <=0.05), removing the occupancy dead-zone cuts grid survival from ~79% (64/81) to ~30% (24/81) at matched 10–20 h repair and 0% (0/81) at slower 24–48 h postmitotic CASM washout.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-020 (#23/52, Keep · Exploratory) (continuous BID failed clinically in NCT05163886 / NCT06215755; pulsed q48h–q72h remains clinically untested) behind a 14-day human iPSC-MN CASM washout and intracellular + secreted DPR mass-balance kill-gate.
